Changes in 0.10.2:

- Every live/single scan now uses the current TONE REF and TONE mode.
- Turning TONE on now starts from the selected reference level immediately.
- Includes PAUSE, MAX/MIN CALC HOLD, MAX EVER markers, 1-second cellular polling, and the v0.10 visual refresh.
